anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
Which behavior should the workspace-switch filter policy select by default when the report view changes workspace?

A) clear - drop every active filter on each switch, so the new workspace opens unfiltered.
B) preserve - keep all active filters across switches, which is what the workspace-change handler in `ui/report-view.ts` does today.
C) restore per workspace - bring back each workspace's last-used filters, which needs per-workspace filter memory beside the resolver's defaults.

Recommendation: B - as the resolver default, it keeps today's behavior unchanged and adds no per-workspace state, while clear and restore stay available as policy values.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
How should the report view handle filters when switching workspaces?
A) Clear all filters on every workspace switch.
B) Preserve all active filters across workspace switches.
C) Restore each workspace’s last filters.
Recommendation: C - preserves each workspace’s context without carrying unrelated filters into another workspace.
